Beim ersten Speichern übernimmt das Pane: On first save the panel takes over Palworld's default values.
Darf alles, auch Spieler kicken und bann: May do everything, including kicking and banning players. Whoever enters this password when joining ends up in the “Admin” group.
Der erste Download ist rund 35 GB groß u: The first download is about 35 GB and takes a while. Needs about 60 GB of free space during installation.
Die App-ID des Servers, nicht des Spiels: The app ID of the server, not of the game. Find it on steamdb.info
The file is created on first start.
Die Datei entsteht beim ersten Start. AR: The file is created on first start. ARK rewrites it on shutdown, so the panel stops the server before saving.
Die Mod-ID aus der Workshop-Beschreibung: The mod ID from the Workshop description, separated by semicolons. Belongs to the Workshop IDs above.
Einstellungen in serverconfig.xml im Ser: Settings are in serverconfig.xml in the server folder. The ports are fixed, so only one 7DTD server per machine is possible.
Enshrouded verlangt für jede Gruppe ein: Enshrouded requires a different password for each group; only “Visitor” may be empty. New servers get random passwords. Enter your own before sharing them.
For mobile, console and Windows Edition.
Für Mods und Plugins, die Fliegen erlaub: For mods and plugins that allow flying
Für die öffentliche Liste braucht Factor: For the public list Factorio needs an account (username/token in the file).
Für jedes Spiel mit Linux-Dedicated-Serv: For any game with a Linux dedicated server that can be downloaded anonymously via SteamCMD. {{port}} in the start command is replaced with the first port.
Für öffentliche Server nötig: steamcommu: Required for public servers: steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers (app ID 730)
Gegner greifen erst an, wenn man sie ang: Enemies only attack once you attack them. Bosses excluded.
Kommagetrennte Modrinth-Namen. Bequemer: Comma-separated Modrinth names. Easier via the “Mods” tab under Manage server.
Konfiguration liegt in Zomboid/Server/<s: The config is in Zomboid/Server/<servername>.ini in the container's home directory.
Leben aller Gegner außer Bossen. 1 = nor: Health of all enemies except bosses. 1 = normal.
Läuft als 64-Bit-Server; die alte 32-Bit: Runs as a 64-bit server; the old 32-bit file replay_srv.so is removed before starting.
Läuft über Wine. Einstellungen in save-d: Runs via Wine. Settings in save-data/Settings/ServerHostSettings.json and ServerGameSettings.json (created on first start). Self-test 10.10.2026: runs stable under Wine, the player query does not answer yet.
Läuft über Wine. Einstellungen in userda: Runs via Wine. Settings in userdata/dedicatedserver.cfg (created on first start). Self-test 10.10.2026: runs stable under Wine, the player query does not answer yet.
Läuft über Wine. Name, Passwörter, Spiel: Runs via Wine. Set name, passwords, game rules and player count under “Settings”. If the server does not show up in the game: Steam → View → Game servers → Favourites → Add a server with IP:15637.
Mehr Ausdauer heißt: Gegner lassen sich: More stamina means enemies are harder to stun. Excluding bosses. 1 = normal.
Mehr Wirkung heißt: mehr Gelände pro Sch: More effect means more terrain per hit and more resources. 1 = normal.
Nach dem Start im Spiel über „Server Man: After starting, enter the address in the game under “Server Manager” and claim the server.
Nummer einer Steam-Workshop-Sammlung mit: Number of a Steam Workshop collection with addons. Also needs a Steam Web API key.
Nutzt das bewährte Image itzg/minecraft-: Uses the proven image itzg/minecraft-server. Mods are downloaded from Modrinth automatically on start.
Nutzt das verbreitete Image factoriotool: Uses the popular image factoriotools/factorio. A map is generated automatically on first start. Settings in config/server-settings.json.
Offizielles TeamSpeak-Image. Der Admin-S: Official TeamSpeak image. The admin key (token=…) appears in the console on first start. The free licence covers up to 32 slots.
Ordner im Serververzeichnis, mit Komma g: Folders in the server directory, comma-separated, e.g. @CBA_A3,@ace. Upload mods via Files.
Palworld braucht viel RAM, 16 GB sind fü: Palworld needs a lot of RAM; 16 GB is recommended for full servers. Settings in Pal/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/PalWorldSettings.ini.
Passwort für die Fernverwaltung. Der RCO: Password for remote administration. The RCON port is never opened to the internet.
Schaden aller Gegner außer Bossen. 1 = n: Damage of all enemies except bosses. 1 = normal.
Servername und Map stehen bei den Start-: Server name and map are in the start settings.
Servername, Schwierigkeit, Spielerzahl u: Server name, difficulty, player count and view distance are in the “Start” tab.
So viele Plätze bleiben für Spieler der: This many slots stay free for players in the “Admin” group, even when the server is otherwise full.
This many slots stay free for players in the “Visitor” group, even when the server is otherwise full.
This many slots stay free for players in the “Friend” group, even when the server is otherwise full.
This many slots stay free for players in the “Guest” group, even when the server is otherwise full.
Speichert beim Stoppen die Welt. Spielst: Saves the world when stopping. Save games are in saves/.
Spieler der Gruppe „Besucher“ dürfen Fla: Players in the “Visitor” group may upgrade flame altars and thereby enlarge bases.
Spieler der Gruppe „Besucher“ dürfen Tru: Players in the “Visitor” group may use chests and storage.
Spieler der Gruppe „Besucher“ dürfen and: Players in the “Visitor” group may remove others from the server.
Spieler der Gruppe „Besucher“ dürfen in: Players in the “Visitor” group may build and demolish in bases.
Spieler der Gruppe „Freund“ dürfen Flamm: Players in the “Friend” group may upgrade flame altars and thereby enlarge bases.
Spieler der Gruppe „Freund“ dürfen Truhe: Players in the “Friend” group may use chests and storage.
Spieler der Gruppe „Freund“ dürfen ander: Players in the “Friend” group may remove others from the server.
Spieler der Gruppe „Freund“ dürfen in Ba: Players in the “Friend” group may build and demolish in bases.
Spieler der Gruppe „Gast“ dürfen Flammen: Players in the “Guest” group may upgrade flame altars and thereby enlarge bases.
Spieler der Gruppe „Gast“ dürfen Truhen: Players in the “Guest” group may use chests and storage.
Spieler der Gruppe „Gast“ dürfen andere: Players in the “Guest” group may remove others from the server.
Spieler der Gruppe „Gast“ dürfen in Base: Players in the “Guest” group may build and demolish in bases.
Spieler in der Konsole mit whitelist add: Add players in the console with whitelist add <name>
Spieler können im Spiel miteinander spre: Players can talk to each other in the game.
Players can text each other in the game.
Standard: Muldraugh, KY. Weitere Karten: Default: Muldraugh, KY. Add more maps from mods with a semicolon before them.
Steam-App-ID des Dedicated Servers: Steam app ID of the dedicated server
Steam-Workshop-Nummern, mit Semikolon ge: Steam Workshop numbers, separated by semicolons, e.g. 2169435993;2392709985. The server downloads them itself on start.
Stichworte, mit denen man den Server in: Keywords for finding the server in the server list, comma-separated. Allowed tags are listed in enshrouded_server_readme.txt in the server folder.
Vanilla-Terraria über das Image ryshe/te: Vanilla Terraria via the image ryshe/terraria. Commands like save or say go through the console.
Von play.eco unter Account. Ohne Token s: From play.eco under Account. Without a token the server starts offline and does not appear in the public list.
Vorgabe für den Schwierigkeitsgrad. Nur: Difficulty preset. The individual values in the Game rules, Players, Enemies and Progression tabs only apply with “Custom”.
Was mit dem Rucksack passiert, wenn ein: What happens to the backpack when a player dies. Lost items lie in the tombstone and can be picked up there.
Was passiert, wenn man ein Tier beim Zäh: What happens when you scare an animal while taming it. Progress is shown in the game with hearts.
Wer beim Beitreten dieses Passwort eingi: Whoever enters this password when joining ends up in the “Visitor” group.
Whoever enters this password when joining ends up in the “Friend” group.
Whoever enters this password when joining ends up in the “Guest” group.
Wer nichts isst oder trinkt, verliert mi: Anyone who does not eat or drink loses health over time until death.
Wie lange Werkbänke zum Herstellen brauc: How long workbenches take to craft. 1 = normal.
Wie lange die Boni von Essen anhalten. 1: How long food buffs last. 1 = normal.
How long a day lasts in the game.
How long a night lasts in the game.
Wie lange man es in sehr kalten Gegenden: How long you can stand very cold areas before getting hypothermia.
Wie lange man hungrig ist, bevor das Ver: How long you are hungry before starvation sets in.
Wie lange man im Nebel (Shroud) bleiben: How long you can stay in the Shroud. 1 = normal.
Wie oft Gegner angreifen. Ohne Bosse. 1: How often enemies attack. Excluding bosses. 1 = normal.
Wie stark die Fische beim Angel-Minispie: How hard fish pull in the fishing minigame.
Wie viel Erfahrung es für Erkunden und A: How much experience exploring and quests give. 1 = normal.
Wie viel Erfahrung es für Kämpfe gibt. 1: How much experience combat gives. 1 = normal.
Wie viel Erfahrung es für das Abbauen vo: How much experience mining resources gives. 1 = normal.
Wie viel Luft man unter Wasser hat. 1 =: How much air you have under water. 1 = normal.
Wie viele Materialien in Truhen, bei bes: How many materials are found in chests, on defeated enemies etc. 1 = normal.
Wie viele Runen das Aufwerten von Waffen: How many runes upgrading weapons costs. 1 = normal.
Wie viele Runen man beim Zerlegen aufgew: How many runes you get back when salvaging upgraded weapons. 1 = normal.
How far enemies see and hear players. Excluding bosses. 1 = normal.
Zomboid lädt die Mods beim Start selbst: Zomboid downloads the mods itself on start. The panel writes them into the server INI under WorkshopItems and Mods.
„In der Nähe“: Man hört nur Spieler in d: “Proximity”: you only hear players nearby. “Global”: everyone hears everyone.
